seeded_payload.research_rationale: EO 10529 (April 22, 1954; 19 FR 2397) was read in the held official FR scan (fr-originals OCR of PDF pages 1-3: heading, enacting clause, sections 1-5, Eisenhower signature and FR Doc. 54-3141). Section 2 begins on page 2397 and continues on page 2399 after the issue's contents pages; the clause is quoted from page 2399. Operative clauses: the Administrator's recommendation of volunteer Federal personnel for State and local pre-emergency civil-defense training (sec. 1); the agency head's year-to-year authorization (sec. 2) and its three conditions (sec. 2(a)-(c)); continued pay, status and travel (sec. 3); a construction rule (sec. 4); and two definitions (sec. 5). There is no expiry, condition or report duty. Later events, read in the held texts: EO 10773 (July 1, 1958), EO 10782 (effective August 26, 1958, renaming the office in EO 10773's substituted references) and EO 11051 section 603(d) (September 27, 1962) only substituted the responsible officials (ODCM/OCDM Director, then OEP Director or Secretary of Defense); they are amendments, not ends. Section 1's reference to section 3 of EO 10346 describes the arrangements the recommendations serve; EO 10346 was revoked by EO 11490 in 1969, but section 1 does not make its own authority depend on EO 10346, and EO 10529 was still being maintained by amendment, so that revocation is not treated as an end. EO 12148 (signed July 20, 1979; 44 FR 43239, held) section 5-104 revokes EO 10529, as amended, and section 6 makes the order effective July 15, 1979; that stated effective date is the first end of every clause and the whole-order end. The OFR catalog and the 1989 OFR Codification disposition table (amended by EOs 10773, 11051; revoked by EO 12148) agree. The current-law machine hits for this order are U.S. Code editorial notes recording its amendments and its revocation by EO 12148, not a continuing basis. No other amendment, revocation or statute affecting EO 10529 was found in the bounded searches listed.

savings_residuals.reason: EO 12148 revokes EO 10529 outright. Its only transition rule, section 2-302, lets the FEMA Director continue to perform functions transferred to him by section 1 of EO 12148 notwithstanding the revocations; that is a continuation of FEMA's own transferred functions, not a saving of EO 10529's terms, and EO 12148 does not re-enact the 40-hour limit or the other conditions of EO 10529. EO 10529 authorized time-limited training assignments while employees stayed in Federal pay status; it created no vested rights, and pay or travel already allowed for past assignments were completed. No surviving effect traceable to EO 10529 was found.
